room_background.prompt: A 3D isometric lay of a cozy developer bedroom, soft warm lighting, containing a desk with dual monitors, a cozy bed, some indoor plants, and a bookshelf. Clean modern aesthetic, highly detailed, perfect for an interactive portfolio.

hero_idle_sprite.prompt: A simple highly aesthetic minimal pixel art 2d sprite of a human indie developer wearing a hoodie, standing, isometric angle. The background MUST BE PURE SOLID WHITE (#FFFFFF). No checkerboard background, strictly a solid white background so it can be easily keyed out. No floor pad/shadow beneath if possible.
hero_idle_sprite.notes: Processed with remove_bg.py to strip the solid white (#FFFFFF) background to transparent before use.

hero_jumping_sprite_sheet.prompt: A simple highly aesthetic minimal pixel art sprite sheet of this specific human indie developer wearing a hoodie jumping. 3x3 grid, sequence, frame by frame animation, square aspect ratio, transparent background. Must look exactly like the reference character.
hero_jumping_sprite_sheet.notes: Processed with split_sprites.py to cut the 3x3 grid into 9 individual frames and save them as an animated GIF with 100ms frame duration.

hero_walking_sprite_sheet.prompt: A 3x3 sprite sheet grid of this exact pixel art character walking. STRICT REQUIREMENTS: There must be exactly 9 distinct, non-overlapping poses arranged in a perfect 3x3 grid. Each frame must show only ONE character body. Pure solid white (#FFFFFF) background. Style must match the reference image exactly.
hero_walking_sprite_sheet.notes: Processed with remove_bg.py first, then split_sprites.py to generate the walking animation GIF. Required strict prompting to ensure no overlapping legs.
